description: An Aserai open-front brown coat with broad gold geometric embroidered borders at the lapels, cuffs and hem, worn over a cream lightweight linen tunic. A maroon and gold patterned woven sash ties at the waist and hangs down the front. Loose cream trousers and low brown leather shoes complete the everyday minor-lord attire. The garments are substantial and opaque, with no headgear, armor or weapons.
